label: For "Parcel Sorting: Label Reading & Address OCR": Read barcodes and address text from parcels on fast conveyors with high first-pass read rate to reduce manual coding. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Test images with clean labels.
